svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.16.4 Penetration of Fire Blocks
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.16.4 Penetration of Fire Blocks
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION

g.text: Pipe through the top plates: the gap
Cable through the top plates: red
Top plates: fire blocks between the
wall space and the floor space

svg.text: Where fire blocks are pierced by pipes, ducts
or other elements, the effectiveness of the
fire blocks is maintained around such elements
This is satisfied by the use of generic firestops
such as mineral wool, gypsum plaster or Portland
cement mortar, or by the use of sealants that
form part of a firestop tested in accordance with
CAN/ULC-S115, "Standard Method of Fire Tests of
Drawn: a wall cut away below a floor. Red outlines: fire blocks. Pipe and cable sizes are illustration only.
